collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2018 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. Please Note: These wiper blades are only for models without integrated washer jets.
